question: Which number set is different? : **(11, 22, 44), (13, 26, 52), (15, 30, 60), (14, 28, 43)**
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: In the first three sets, each number is **double** the previous number.

Given,

(11, 22, 44), (13, 26, 52), (15, 30, 60), (14, 28, 43)

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) (11,22,44)

⇒ 11 × 2 = 22&l
